quickAnswer: The fastest ephesus to pamukkale transport is a 2.5-to-3-hour private drive along the Aydın–Denizli corridor (roughly 190 km). body.text: How long is the drive from Selçuk/Ephesus to Pamukkale (2.5–3 hours)?

Driving from Selçuk or Ephesus to [Hierapolis and Pamukkale](https://www.muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?DistId=PMK&SectionId=PMK01) covers roughly 190 kilometres and takes 2.5 to 3 hours via the Aydın–Denizli motorway and D320 corridor. With the full Aydın–Denizli motorway open, traffic moves far faster than the old town-by-town highway through Nazilli.

If you are staying in Kuşadası rather than Selçuk, add 20 to 25 minutes at the start of the drive. A private driver or rental car lets you drop luggage directly at your Pamukkale or Karahayıt hotel—or store bags safely in the locked boot while touring the travertines and Hierapolis ruins, where foreign visitor entry is 30 EUR via [Turkish Museums](https://muze.gov.tr/urun-ekle?catalogNo=WEB-PMK01-87-009) and the North and South gates close at 18:00 (pedestrian gate at 17:00).
Can you take the regional TCDD train from Selçuk to Denizli?

Yes. [TCDD Taşımacılık](https://www.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr/seferler/basmane-denizli) operates several daily regional trains along the İzmir (Basmane)–Selçuk–Denizli line, taking roughly 3 hours 15 minutes to 3 hours 40 minutes from Selçuk station to Denizli central station. Trains are clean, air-conditioned, and inexpensive, making them a relaxed alternative to intercity buses.

Because regional trains on the [Basmane–Denizli route](https://railturkey.org/travel/trains/regional/izmirdenizli/) do not always allow advance seat selection months ahead on the [TCDD e-ticket portal](https://ebilet.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr/), travellers typically buy tickets online a few days prior or at Selçuk station 20–30 minutes before departure. Upon arriving at Denizli Gar, walk across the road to Denizli Otogar (lower platform) for a frequent 25-minute dolmuş to Pamukkale village, or take a 20-minute taxi straight to the South Gate.
How do you add Aphrodisias along the way?

To include [Aphrodisias Museum and Archaeological Site](https://muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?SectionId=AFR01&DistId=AFR) between Ephesus and Pamukkale, turn south off the D320 near Kuyucak toward Karacasu and Geyre village—a detour of roughly 40 minutes each way plus 90 minutes on site. That turns a 3-hour transfer into a well-paced 6-hour cultural day with zero backtracking.

Aphrodisias houses the ancient world's best-preserved 30,000-seat marble stadium, the monumental Tetrapylon gate, and an on-site sculpture museum. Public transport connections to Geyre are sparse and impractical with suitcases, so hire a private driver or self-drive if Aphrodisias is on your list. Leaving Selçuk at 08:30 puts you at Aphrodisias by 10:45 and into Pamukkale by 15:00—right in time for late-afternoon light on the travertines.
Should you continue to Antalya or fly out of Denizli (DNZ)?

Continue overland to Antalya (3 to 3.5 hours) or Fethiye (3 hours) if your trip moves next to the Mediterranean coast; fly out of Denizli Çardak Airport (DNZ) if you are returning straight to Istanbul. Both Turkish Airlines (to IST) and [AJet](https://ajet.com/en/flights-from-denizli-to-istanbul) / Pegasus (to SAW) operate daily 70-minute flights from DNZ to Istanbul.

Keep in mind that Denizli Çardak Airport lies roughly 65 kilometres (60 to 70 minutes by car) east of Pamukkale village. Because evening flights from DNZ are limited to a handful of departures, confirm flight times before deciding whether to overnight in Pamukkale or visit on a same-day transfer from Selçuk.

items: Verify current TCDD Basmane–Denizli departure times on [ebilet.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr](https://ebilet.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr/) the week of travel.
Start from Selçuk by 08:30 if adding Aphrodisias so you reach Pamukkale before the 18:00 South/North Gate closing time.
Carry an extra pair of socks or light sandals for walking barefoot across Pamukkale's warm travertine terraces.
Allow at least 75 minutes for the road transfer from Pamukkale village to Denizli Çardak Airport (DNZ).

faq.q: Does the TCDD train stop right at Pamukkale?
faq.a: No. The train stops at Denizli central station, about 18 kilometres south of Pamukkale; from Denizli, take a 20-minute taxi or a 25-minute dolmuş from the bus station across the street.

faq.q: Can I visit Ephesus and Pamukkale on the same day?
faq.a: Doing both in one day is rushed—Ephesus requires 3 hours, the drive takes 2.5–3 hours, and Hierapolis/Pamukkale needs at least 3 hours. Staying one night in Selçuk and one night near Pamukkale is far better paced.

faq.q: Are there direct flights from Denizli (DNZ) to Antalya or Cappadocia?
faq.a: No direct scheduled flights connect Denizli (DNZ) to Antalya or Cappadocia; DNZ primarily serves Istanbul (IST and SAW), while Antalya and Fethiye are reached overland by road.

faq.q: Is the Aydın–Denizli highway a toll road?
faq.a: Yes. The Aydın–Denizli motorway uses Türkiye's electronic HGS toll system, which cuts travel time significantly compared with the older D320 state road through town centres.

faq.q: Can I store luggage at Pamukkale if I take the train?
faq.a: Small cafés and tour offices near the lower Pamukkale village entrance offer informal paid bag storage, though booking a private driver or staying overnight is much more secure for full suitcases.

faq.q: How much time should I budget at Aphrodisias?
faq.a: Plan 90 minutes to 2 hours to walk the marble stadium, Tetrapylon, Sebasteion reliefs, and the Aphrodisias Museum before continuing 90 minutes onward to Pamukkale.
